io.github.jabrena.juno.backend
Code generation: turns optimized Juno IR into a complete Arduino sketch, generated assembly plus the C++ runtime shim it links against, for every supported board.
io.github.jabrena.juno.board
Juno's model of a compilation target: Board, resolved from the entry-point class's @Board annotation (see Board) via Board.fromApiClassName(String), or the explicitly requested board when the entry point carries no annotation.
